body:
_Migrated from issue #1201, filed 2026-07-28._

## Symptom

The Docker integration suite reports `37 passed, 1 skipped, 80 errors` on every run. All 80 are setup errors, not test failures — the fixtures never start a container, so nothing under `tests/docker/` or most of `tests/integration/` has actually exercised anything for some time.

The run that surfaced it: [main, run 30368194975](https://github.com/new-usemame/Calibre-Web-NextGen/actions/runs/30368194975) (`Integration Tests (Docker)` = failure). Same on the PR #1098 run.

## Root cause

`tests/docker/` is a directory named after a real PyPI distribution (`docker`, the Docker SDK), and it carries an `__init__.py`, so it is a *regular* package. `tests/conftest.py` put `tests/` itself on `sys.path[0]` (to import `quarantine` by bare name), which promotes every directory under `tests/` to a top-level module. `import docker` therefore resolved to `tests/docker/__init__.py` rather than the SDK.

Proven directly in the pytest harness:

```
SYSPATH0: .../repo/tests
DOCKER:   .../repo/tests/docker/__init__.py
```

`import docker` then *succeeds*, which is why the failure was so hard to read — it surfaced deep inside a dependency as:

```
File "testcontainers/core/docker_client.py", line 27, in <module>
    from docker.context import ContextAPI
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'docker.context'
```

`tests/conftest.py::cwa_container` opens with `from testcontainers.compose import DockerCompose`, so every test depending on that fixture errors at setup.

Four modules put the tests root on `sys.path`: `tests/conftest.py` (two sites), `tests/docker/conftest.py`, `tests/integration/test_ingest_pipeline.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_test_lanes.py`.

`tests/docker/__init__.py` came in with `c9e07cc08` (2025-12-01, inherited from upstream CWA), so the collision has been latent since then. It only started biting when the unpinned `testcontainers>=3.7.0` rolled forward to a version whose compose backend imports `docker.context`.

## Why nobody noticed

`Integration Tests (Docker)` is `continue-on-error` outside `safe-tier-2` PRs, and the summary job only prints `⚠️ Integration tests failed (advisory; not a tier-2 PR)`. So the whole workflow reported **success** with 80 errors in it.

The other edge of that: on a `safe-tier-2` PR the job *is* a hard gate, so tier-2 auto-merge cannot currently fire at all.

## Fix

Make `tests/` a real package and import its helpers as `tests.<module>`, so nothing needs the tests root on `sys.path` and no directory under `tests/` can ever shadow an installed distribution again.

Related gate-integrity issues: #1105, #953, #1017.
title: CI: the Docker integration suite is dead — tests/docker/ shadows the Docker SDK
